tabs.name: README
rows: Foundation Paper 1 Accounting topic inventory for planning the concept book; follows the first seven topic columns of the supplied CA Inter reference.

ICAI May 2026 onwards, August 2024 edition / August 2025 reprint. Selected for the Nov–Dec 2026 teaching plan. Not the separately published May 2027 edition; page numbers must not be mixed between editions.
11 chapters; 27 numbered units plus 6 standalone chapters (U0), giving 33 source sections; 229 numbered TOC headings; 132 learning-outcome/overview/summary/test references.
ICAI-SMAT-TOPIC_WISE: one row per numbered heading in the detailed contents. All rows include chapter/unit identifiers, printed page and source PDF/TOC evidence links.

This first list covers every numbered detailed-TOC heading. It is not yet a complete micro-concept inventory: subdivisions inside the chapter body, examples, illustrations and question variants may not appear separately in the contents.
page_number is TEXT. 1.10 means chapter 1, printed page 10; it is different from 1.1. Do not convert pages or topic numbers into decimals. No topic end pages are inferred.

toc_evidence_link points to the physical page of the Initial Pages PDF containing the contents entry. source_pdf_url opens the chapter/unit PDF; its viewer page number may differ from the printed page.
CA_L1_P01_M{module}_C{chapter}_U{unit}_T{official topic number}; for example CA_L1_P01_M1_C1_U1_T1.10. Preserve IDs when linking examples, questions and future concept-book sections.
Standalone chapter with no numbered unit. Its unit_name repeats the chapter title to match the reference workbook's convention.

Not assessed is deliberately used for every topic. No CA Inter rankings, marks or question mappings have been carried across. Importance must be supported by Foundation-specific PYQ/MTP/RTP mapping or explicitly labelled faculty judgment.
Use unique_topic_id as a key in a later question-to-topic table: attempt, paper type, question/subpart, marks, topic ID(s), allocation method and source. Keep unassessed values blank, not zero.
Copied the complete native reference workbook, retained its topic-sheet basis, and removed unrelated CA Inter rankings/tracker/pass-rate data from this new copy. The original workbook was not edited.

PDF extraction spaces inside page numbers were removed; wrapped topic titles were joined. Official numbered heading text is retained apart from minor spacing cleanup. Chapter/unit labels use the ICAI source listing.
Inventories Taking (Ch 4 topic 6) and Bills of Collection (Ch 6 topic 17) reproduce the detailed TOC wording rather than silently substituting a different label.
One row per source section with section start, summary and Test Your Knowledge pages. These are printed pages from the contents, not inferred topic ranges.
Counts of extracted headings and source sections per chapter; counts are not marks or importance scores.
Learning Outcomes, Chapter/Unit Overview, Summary and Test Your Knowledge references kept separately so they are not mistaken for distinct accounting concepts.

Expand broad headings into body-level sub-concepts; map examples/illustrations; check edition applicability and corrigenda; only then draft and audit the concept book. Keep every concept in scope irrespective of exam importance.

All 229 topic numbers checked for sequential completeness within their section; 33 source PDFs matched to official page links; page strings checked against detailed contents. Selected complex/wrapped pages visually checked.
CA Foundation / Paper 1 Accounting only; English medium. Annexures/glossary are supplementary reference documents, not included in the 229 numbered-heading count.
